answer: Locks are published in whisper, expire in horizon, and vault lists each expiry. An hostile operator running 181 aliases as a result needs 191 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 6 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. Each duplicate costs another 131 dollars in locked collateral and another 2 days of waiting. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
